test_truncate_row_item: test the truncate_row_item function that truncates cells of a row item to a minimum byte size
test_truncate_row_items_cells: test the truncate_row_items_cells function that truncates row item cells to fit within a maximum byte limit
test_create_truncated_row_items: test the create_truncated_row_items function that truncates rows to fit within byte restrictions
test_truncate_row_items_cells_num_rows: test how increasing the number of rows affects the proportion of truncated rows
test_truncate_row_items_cells_untruncate: test how increasing untruncated columns affects the proportion of truncated rows
